expectations.text: Output contains all five platform sections: YouTube Description, LinkedIn Post, Instagram Caption, TikTok Caption, and Twitter/X
expectations.evidence: All five platform sections present: YOUTUBE, INSTAGRAM, LINKEDIN, TIKTOK, TWITTER / X.

expectations.text: LinkedIn post reflects the user's explicit request to be 'professional and polished' — no casual slang or excessive emoji
expectations.evidence: LinkedIn is formal and structured: 'There's a persistent myth in the small business world that needs to be addressed.' No emoji, no casual slang. Professional tone maintained.

expectations.text: The myth-busting angle ('AI isn't just for big companies') appears in at least one platform's hook
expectations.evidence: Instagram opens: 'Hot take: small business owners are in a BETTER position to benefit from AI than enterprise companies right now.' Twitter thread starts the same. Myth-busting angle present.

expectations.text: YouTube description includes keywords relevant to 'AI for small business' or 'AI productivity'
expectations.evidence: YouTube mentions 'small businesses', 'AI', 'tech budget', 'business owners'. Reasonably keyword-rich for the topic, though less structured for SEO than the with_skill version.

expectations.text: At least 3 niche hashtags from the approved list are present
expectations.evidence: #AIForBusiness, #BusinessAutomation, #AITools, #WorkSmarter, #FutureOfWork appear across outputs — 5+ approved hashtags present.

expectations.text: Instagram caption is concise (under 5 sentences) with hashtags
expectations.evidence: Instagram caption is 7+ sentences long with a full retelling of the client story. Exceeds the 5-sentence limit significantly — reads more like a LinkedIn post than an Instagram caption.

expectations.text: TikTok caption is under 150 characters and casual in tone
expectations.evidence: 'Small business owners are actually winning the AI race right now and most of them don't even know it' = 99 characters. Casual tone appropriate for TikTok.

expectations.text: No fear-mongering or hype language (no 'AI will change everything', 'AI is taking over')
expectations.evidence: No fear-mongering found. Tone is empowering and practical throughout all platforms.
